response.text: The 2000 balance exceeds the open invoices by 18.00, which is explained by invoice 285. I'll submit.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", s.cr FROM "APINVH" i JOIN (SELECT "JRNL_NO", SUM("CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE TRIM("ACCT_CD")='2000' GROUP BY 1) s ON s."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE i."INV_ID"=285 AND s.cr<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 285 (INV_AMT 19756.55) is recorded in journal 1452 at 19774.55 (debit expense and credit AP 2000), an 18.00 overstatement. The invoice is marked paid for 19756.55.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT "JRNL_NO", SUM("DR_AMT") dr, SUM("CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "JRNL_NO"=2034 GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM("DR_AMT")<>SUM("CR_AMT")
findings.summary: Journal 2034 (invoice 647) debits 7439.39 but credits 7448.39 (9.00 out of balance). The AP credit matches the invoice and the expense debit is short.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT "JRNL_NO", SUM("DR_AMT") dr, SUM("CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "JRNL_NO"=2386 GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM("DR_AMT")<>SUM("CR_AMT")
findings.summary: Manual accrual journal 2386 (RLOPEZ) debits 3579.03 but credits 3588.03 (9.00 out of balance).

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", c."ACTV_FLG" FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLCOA" c ON TRIM(c."ACCT_CD")=TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") WHERE c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'
findings.summary: Journal 1629 posts 641.63 to account 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous, which is retired (ACTV_FLG=N). The memo says the charge should go to 5500 Travel.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."POST_DT", h."PRD_ID", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IN (2430,2431,2432) AND p."STAT_CD"='C'
findings.summary: Rent invoices 802 and 803 (journals 2431 and 2432) were posted into closed periods 8 and 9. Their journal numbers (2431 and 2432) come after the entire journal sequence, including period 11-12 entries, so they were keyed after those periods closed. Credit memo 801 (journal 2430) is in the same position, closed period 9, with an out-of-sequence number.
